title: Cloud Secret and Object Collection
description: Surfaces identities accessing secrets and object data after cloud discovery, emphasizing behavior that can precede data theft or credential compromise.
query: 'Log Source' = 'OCI Audit Logs' and ('Event Type' like 'com.oraclecloud.vault.getsecret*' or 'Event Type' like 'com.oraclecloud.objectstorage.getobject' or 'Event Type' like 'com.oraclecloud.objectstorage.createpreauthenticatedrequest') and Status = 'Success' | stats count as CollectionEvents, distinctcount('Resource Name') as Resources, unique('Event Type') as Actions by 'User Name', 'Source IP' | where CollectionEvents >= 2 | sort -Resources

ask_ai_prompts: List the secrets and objects collected by each identity and source IP.
Which accesses followed discovery or credential changes in the same time window?
